cases.message: This is a machine-checked acceptance task using only synthetic content. Follow every instruction exactly. First call write_todos with these five todo contents in this order: plan acceptance; delegate child analyses; write deterministic artifacts; verify persisted artifacts; finish acceptance. On every assistant turn that uses tools, call exactly one tool; never batch tool calls. Call the task tool twice, sequentially, with subagent_type general-purpose. The first child must write exactly P1_4_CHILD_A_OK to /acceptance/child-a.txt and return exactly P1_4_CHILD_A_DONE. The second child must write exactly P1_4_CHILD_B_OK to /acceptance/child-b.txt and return exactly P1_4_CHILD_B_DONE. Then write exactly P1_4_PARENT_OK to /acceptance/parent.txt. Next create sixteen files sequentially with one write_file call per turn: /acceptance/progress-01.txt through /acceptance/progress-16.txt. Each file content must be exactly its two-digit number, for example 01 for progress-01.txt and 16 for progress-16.txt. Then read /acceptance/child-a.txt and /acceptance/child-b.txt with separate read_file calls. Finally call write_todos once more with the same five todo contents, all status completed, and return a concise completion message. Do not use shell, Memory, external systems, extra file paths or additional todo items. Do not stop before all exact files and completed todos exist.
